decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core 2K spraying expertise into heavy-duty corrosion protection, a durable niche where newly launched industrial equipment is rarely withdrawn after one year.
The low-pressure injection pump is close to the established construction repair and injection offer, has its own web page, and costs little to keep in the portfolio.
The multi-model low-pressure transfer pump line serves the broad material conveying business and supports system sales, so dropping it soon after launch is unlikely.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's digitalization and process-control strategy, adds value to coating systems, and is prominently presented on its own page.
